newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African advertising plans levy to fund bodies.
newsitem.headline: S.African advertising plans levy to fund bodies.

text.p: South Africa's advertising industry said on Friday it was creating a Marketing Industry Trust to administer collection of funds from the media to fund the Advertising Research Foundation, the Advertising Standards Authority and other industry initiatives.
The Trust, which meets for the first time on January 23, will agree on a levy to be applied on an add-on basis to media rates. The media will be the sole source of levy collection.
The move ends recent uncertainty about the future of the South African Advertising Research Foundation and the Advertising Standards Authority.
